item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's teacher writes 'air' on the blackboard and asks the class how it should be classified. Meena knows that air contains nitrogen, oxygen, argon, carbon dioxide and water vapour, and that these gases are mixed together without chemically combining with one another.

How should air be classified?

options.A: A compound, because it contains more than one kind of substance
options.B: An element, because the gases in it keep their own properties
options.C: A mixture, because several gases are present together without being chemically combined
options.D: A pure substance, because it looks uniform and has no visible parts
